articles.summary: Parasail is an AI inference platform that orchestrates workloads across a global supply of GPUs to hit a target combination of price, performance, reliability and scale for their customers. By working with Shadeform, Parasail can seamlessly deploy the right hardware for their customer needs across 30+ vetted providers, both instantly for burst workloads and within an hour for complex cluster requirements.
articles.title: How Parasail turns around any customer GPU requirement in under an hour using Shadeform
